005package org.wpilib.epilogue;
006
007import org.wpilib.framework.RobotBase;
008import org.wpilib.framework.TimedRobot;
009
010/**
011 * Service for logging telemetry via Epilogue, starting from a root robot object. Service
012 * implementations are automatically generated at compile-time: every class that extends {@code
013 * RobotBase} gets its own service class. These are queried by {@link Epilogue#update(RobotBase)}
014 * and {@link Epilogue#bind(TimedRobot)}.
015 *
016 * @param <R> The specific type of {@link RobotBase} that this service supports.
017 */
018public interface EpilogueService<R extends RobotBase> {
019  /**
020   * Checks if this service supports the given root robot object.
021   *
022   * @param root The root robot object
023   * @return True if this service specifically supports the given root robot object, false
024   *     otherwise. This returns true if and only if the root robot is of the exact type {@code R};
025   *     subclasses of {@code R} are not supported.
026   */
027  boolean supportsExactly(RobotBase root);
028
029  /**
030   * Updates telemetry for the given root robot object.
031   *
032   * @param root the root robot object
033   */
034  void update(R root);
035
036  /**
037   * A specialization of {@link EpilogueService} that can be bound to a {@link TimedRobot}.
038   *
039   * @param <R> The specific type of {@link TimedRobot} that this service supports.
040   */
041  interface Bindable<R extends TimedRobot> extends EpilogueService<R> {
042    /**
043     * Binds a periodic update to a root timed robot instance.
044     *
045     * @param root the root timed robot instance
046     */
047    void bind(R root);
048  }
049}
